  2. Exterior & Design

Reliable exterior lights and helpful door mirrors

Proposal
1, implement. Exterior lighting draws 26 rows with 19 defects (failed or falsely reported lamps); door mirrors 28 rows with 11 wishes for kerb tilt and auto-fold that previous 1 Series had.
Horizon
H1. Production quality and software functions.
Domain
Exterior & Design
Markets
EU
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-F70-EU-EX-01 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

Exterior lights shall work without fault messages; door mirrors shall tilt down on the kerb side when reversing and fold automatically when locking.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
EULighting defect rows<= 5 per 6 months (today 19)Customer feedbackassumption
EUKerb-side mirror tilt in reverseStandard on all variantsOffer checkassumption
